answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the jade of the next round. By the umber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
